items.title: Sharpest home loan drop on record as property investors exit market
items.summary: Investor loans fell by 31 per cent in the three months to September, a fact welcomed by Housing Minister Clare O'Neil despite more modest falls for homebuyer loans.

items.title: David Jones's receiver reveals list of 19 stores set to close
items.summary: The retailer, which has 38 stores nationally, was placed in voluntary administration less than a week ago. Staff in the affected locations are being briefed.

aus.headline: Investor Home Loans Plunge
aus.body: Investor loans dropped 31% over the September quarter, the sharpest fall on record.
aus.why: Property investors are pulling back from the housing market.

us.headline: Wall Street Rallies On AI
us.body: US share indexes jumped after CoreWeave posted strong quarterly results and guidance.
us.why: Wall Street often sets the tone for the ASX the next day.

biz.headline: David Jones To Shut 19 Stores
biz.body: The receiver for David Jones has named 19 of its 38 stores that will close.
biz.why: Staff at the affected stores are now being briefed.
